# `search.code`

Search code across repositories

Multi-repo code search over Ruk with a composite continuation; an owner and repo scope narrows to one repository with a verbatim Ruk cursor. Pages carry the continuation in the body and emit no Link header; an expired lease reports lease-conflict and the client restarts from page one. Blobs over 512 KiB are skipped; rukie holds no result cache.

- Method and path: `GET /search`
- Scope: `repo:read`
- Kind: `read`
- CLI: `rukie search code`
- MCP: `search_code`
- ETag: served; send it back as If-Match to write safely
